exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Only ~".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Noun しか～ない matches "Only ~".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Noun しか～ない.
exercises.explanation: Expresses that there is nothing except the specified noun; only that exists.
